label: 盒盖 · 横版重构（high）
prompt: Flat print-ready front artwork for a board game box lid, landscape, full bleed to all four edges, seen perfectly straight-on. Only the 2D artwork itself: no box, no spine, no box edges or corners, no 3D mockup, no table, no room light, no cast shadows, no perspective distortion. Recreate the box cover design of the first reference image as faithfully as possible, the same artwork re-composed for a wider landscape frame: the same retro constructivist propaganda-poster style with a heroic low angle, the same bold flat shapes, aged paper grain, fine halftone and worn ink texture, and the same palette of warm cream, vermilion red, terracotta orange, mustard, deep teal, slate blue-grey and near-black green ink. At the top, the same huge, heavy, chunky, slightly distressed hand-lettered title 我不是韭菜！ in near-black green ink on one line across the upper third: exactly these five Chinese characters followed by a bold exclamation mark, letterforms matching the second reference image. Below the right end of the title, the small dark serif line I'M NOT A LEEK! on two lines. Behind the title, sunburst rays alternating cream and vermilion fan out from the building. In the middle, the same neoclassical stock exchange with a triangular pediment carved with the word EXCHANGE, tall columns, a red vertical banner reading BUY on the left and one reading SELL on the right, small red flags on the roofline; angular teal and grey skyscrapers and red flags fan out on both sides and extend to fill the wider frame. In front, the same six animal characters with exactly the same designs, clothes and poses as the third reference image, seen from below like monuments, standing behind a dark teal stone parapet along the bottom edge: on the left an elephant in a dark suit and teal tie raising its trunk, a stern owl in a suit in front of it; in the center the tallest figure, a cheetah with a long red scarf flowing in the wind, looking up to the right; then a meerkat with crossed arms, a fox in a dark suit, and on the right a green chameleon in a suit with a curled tail; a red rising arrow block at the lower right. Spread the group a little wider so each character has room to breathe. Keep the title, the English line and every face well inside the frame, at least 7 percent away from each edge, because the outer edge will be trimmed. No other text, no numbers, no logos, no real brands, no pandas, no real people.

label: 侧标 · 金色标题
prompt: A horizontal title lockup for the long side panel of the board game box in the first reference image, on a fully transparent background. The Chinese title 我不是韭菜！ on one single horizontal line, in the same heavy, chunky, slightly distressed hand-lettered style as the title on the box, in flat matte antique-gold ink (#C2A15F) with a subtle worn print texture; directly to its right, the small gold serif text I'M NOT A LEEK! stacked on three short lines exactly like on the box spine in the second reference image. Flat 2D, perfectly straight-on, no box, no shadow, no background color, no frame, nothing else. Exactly these characters, no other text.

label: 侧标 · 金色图标
prompt: Three separate emblem icons copied from the gold icons printed on the dark spine of the board game box (first reference image, enlarged in the second reference image), on a fully transparent background, in one horizontal row with wide empty gaps between them, each the same height and centered vertically: (1) a classical exchange building with a triangular pediment, four columns and a stepped base; (2) a rising bar chart with an upward zigzag arrow, standing on a row of stacked coins; (3) a bundle of upward arrows rising from a small stepped base. Simple bold solid shapes in flat matte antique-gold ink (#C2A15F) with a subtle worn print texture, consistent weight, no text, no letters, no numbers, no shadow, no background color, nothing else.
